item.title: ‘I belong to Saudi Arabia’ – Cristiano Ronaldo

item.title: Nigerian govt to stop payments to contractors hoarding advance funds – Umahi
item.description: Minister of Works, David Umahi has issued a firm warning to contractors holding Advance Payment Guarantees, APGs, for years without commencing work, directing them to return to their project sites immediately or forfeit further financial approvals. item.title: Ireti Kingibe laments low turnout in FCT area council elections

item.title: Ogun govt denies endorsing any candidate for Awujale of Ijebuland

item.title: Taraba varsity ASUU disowns alleged VC suspension meeting
item.description: The Academic Staff Union of Universities, ASUU, Taraba State University chapter has distanced itself from reports alleging that it participated in a meeting where the Vice Chancellor, Professor Sunday Paul Bako, was suspended.
